WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility, Dark Mode & VPAT 2.5

Users who rely on screen readers (Narrator, NVDA, JAWS), full keyboard navigation, Windows Contrast Themes, or Dark Mode must complete your installer before they can ever open your application. Every binary in RaggieSoft Installer Studio enforces WCAG 2.2 Level AA and Revised Section 508 engineering rules.

Native Win32 Accessibility & Dark Mode Safeguards

  • Genuine BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON Option Cards: Every wizard mode card is a full-width Win32 radio control (>= 68px tall, exceeding WCAG 2.5.8 target size) subclassed via SetWindowSubclass so UI Automation announces its native RadioButton role, state, and description while GDI+ draws crisp vector icons and a 2.5px focus ring.
  • Dark-Mode-Safe Checkboxes (AttachAccessibleCheckboxSubclass): Standard Win32 ComCtl32 v6 checkboxes ignore WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC and paint black text on dark backgrounds. Our shared subclass renders crisp 15.8:1 WCAG AAA labels and focus rings across SetupWizard.exe, InstallerStudio.exe, and RaggieSoftHelp.exe.
  • Dark-Mode-Safe ListView Column Headers (AttachDarkAwareListViewSubclass): Custom-paints SysHeader32 (including trailing unoccupied header space) in Midnight Navy (#0B132B) with #F8FAFC labels in Dark Mode and Slate (#E2E8F0) in Light Mode.
  • Dark-Mode-Safe Push Buttons & Combos (AttachAccessiblePushButtonSubclass): Custom-paints native Win32 BS_PUSHBUTTON and BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON controls (with Royal Cobalt primary fills, Slate-Navy secondary fills, UAC shield icons, and High-Contrast fallback) while keeping 100% native UI Automation Button semantics and Alt+Key mnemonics.
  • Live OS Light <-> Dark Hot-Swapping (ImmersiveColorSet): All four GUI apps listen for WM_SETTINGCHANGE (ImmersiveColorSet & SPI_SETHIGHCONTRAST), WM_SYSCOLORCHANGE, and WM_THEMECHANGED to flip DWM frames, controls, and RichEdit typography live on screen without restarting.
  • Windows Contrast Themes (SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST): Automatically steps aside decorative gradients in favor of pure OS COLOR_WINDOW, COLOR_WINDOWTEXT, and COLOR_HIGHLIGHT tokens.

Automated Per-Project VPAT 2.5 Conformance Reports

Run instbuild.exe --emit-vpat MyApp.rsip out (or click VPAT 2.5 on the IDE toolbar) to audit your manifest's foreground/background hex contrast ratios, keyboard mnemonics, and silent enterprise CLI switches and emit a standalone HTML5 Accessibility Conformance Report ready for institutional procurement review.
